headline: JD.com Misses Q3 Profit Estimates Amid Weak Chinese Consumer Spending
summary: JD.com missed quarterly profit expectations despite a 22.6% rise in net income to 6.5 billion yuan, impacted by sluggish retail spending and food delivery expansion costs.
why: JD.com is one of China's largest e-commerce platforms, making its financial performance a barometer for Chinese consumer demand.

impacts.name: JD.com
impacts.why: Net profit fell short of analyst consensus due to weak retail demand and high competitive spend.
